summary: Say the counting numbers out loud from 1 to 20 by ones, with little or no help.
Recognize written numbers from 1 to 10 and say their names when you see them.
Know a written number stands for how many, and start writing numbers 0 to 10 with help.
Count up to 10 things (5 if scattered) to say how many, and see 3 or 4 at a glance.
Match one to one to solve problems, like getting just enough cups, and to compare amounts.
Compare two groups of up to 5 and say which has more, less or the same.
Add to, put together, take apart and take away with up to 5 objects.
Start to show a simple story problem with pictures or drawings.
Sort, order and make patterns with objects by features like color, length or size.
Describe everyday things with size words like long, short, tall, heavy, light and full.
Compare up to 5 objects by size or how much they hold, and put them in order.
Follow and use position words like in, under, between and behind.
Name and describe flat shapes like circles, squares and triangles, and some solids like cubes.
Match, sort and combine flat shapes into pictures, and build with blocks and other solids.
